views.name: Render sequence
views.summary: Follow a render request through the selected architecture state.

views.name: Pretext sizing
views.summary: Prepare text once, wrap at readable width, return measured card geometry. Server font host remains to be validated.

views.name: Layout sequence
views.summary: Responsibilities of the proposed single layout owner; engine selection is still open.

nodes.name: Render driver
nodes.description: Current paintArchitecture orchestrates relieveCongestion, route painting, label settlement, card painting and atlas creation. This sequence groups those helper calls by responsibility; it is not a new runtime module.

nodes.name: Card text
nodes.description: Current fittedSize measures title widths and reduces type size to its floor. SVG card painting then applies measured ellipsis to titles and single-line responsibilities. The existing font measurement engine remains authoritative.

nodes.name: Grid placement
nodes.description: Current layoutArchitecture uses region bands, global rows and paired seats. cardHeight is46 or58 units depending on responsibility presence. Card text does not grow the card; title size fits the available width.

nodes.name: Route planning
nodes.description: Current relieveCongestion counts planned channel traffic and expands gaps before final routeEdges. Routes use grid bands/corridors. Label settlement happens later in paintEdges, before marks are emitted.

nodes.name: SVG marks
nodes.responsibility: Fits and paints the final marks
nodes.description: Current paintCard truncates title and responsibility using real font metrics. The architecture painter also settles edge-label boxes, emits marks and derives atlas bounds from actual geometry.

flows.name: Today: fit text after choosing seats

steps.label: Repeat placement if gaps need air
Derive atlas from final drawn bounds

beats.heading: Fixed space comes first
beats.body: The grid chooses card space. Text fitting reduces the title size, and painting may still ellipsize it. Responsibilities remain one line. This is the behavior the proposal replaces.

beats.heading: Routing and labels follow placement
beats.body: Congestion relief can expand grid gaps and repeat placement. Final routes are produced after that; label boxes are settled in the architecture paint orchestration. The existing renderer already returns SVG and matching atlas bounds.

nodes.name: Render driver
nodes.description: PROPOSED architecture orchestration: derive semantic graph, request measured card/text/label sizes, call one compound placement-and-routing owner, then paint its complete drawing. External renderer response stays SVG, dimensions and atlas. Parent proposal: Semantic renderer / Readable layout.

nodes.name: Card measurement
nodes.description: PROPOSED replacement for fitting text into preselected card seats. Pretext is the preferred candidate for paragraph preparation and wrapping; use prepareWithSegments once per text/font/config, layoutWithLines for chosen content width and explicit line height. Our policy owns min/max width, padding, icon space, title/body styles and minimum height. Output exact lines with widths/baselines and outer card size, plus measured edge-label sizes. Long descriptions stay in inspector. Server Canvas/font host compatibility must be proved before adoption.

nodes.name: Compound layout
nodes.description: PROPOSED replacement of grid placement plus separate indexed-corridor routing. Accept semantic parent/child graph, relationships and measured node/label dimensions. One established compound layout engine, still to be selected, solves local sibling placement and cross-container routes with real obstacle and whitespace constraints. Its adapter returns final node/container boxes, ports, paths and label boxes together. Steps in the sequence show responsibilities, not a promised engine algorithm or one-pass implementation.

nodes.name: SVG marks
nodes.description: PROPOSED painter takes a complete placed drawing, theme and standing. Paint exact wrapped lines at supplied baselines and use the supplied node/edge/label boxes. No second title fitting, ellipsis, route planning or label relocation in the architecture painter. Derive interaction atlas and document bounds from the same drawing. Data-flow rendering stays on its existing path.

nodes.name: Pretext
nodes.description: Preferred candidate: @chenglou/pretext, https://github.com/chenglou/pretext. prepareWithSegments(text,font,options) measures and segments; layoutWithLines(prepared,maxWidth,lineHeight) returns lines, widths and height. Reuse prepared handles for width trials. Pretext does not choose card width, padding or lineHeight. Current upstream requires Canvas2D measurement and Intl.Segmenter; server support is not a proven drop-in. Verified upstream measurement.ts has no public injection API. Prefer preserving our existing font-file measurer behind a supported adapter; upstream change or an evaluated adaptation is needed. No package is installed by this proposal.

nodes.name: Server font host
nodes.description: OPEN integration requirement, not implemented. Prefer a supported Pretext measurement adapter calling Archboard measureLineIn with the exact bundled fonts. Current upstream has no injection API: this needs upstream support or an explicitly evaluated maintained adaptation. Alternative: server Canvas2D with registered bundled fonts, validated against browser text. Bun currently provides neither OffscreenCanvas nor document. Avoid fake global canvas shims. Source pinned for this review: https://github.com/chenglou/pretext/blob/5ac3fd17ff8079274f45103bf09e294ac345c187/src/measurement.ts

beats.heading: Compare the same render request
beats.body: Compare the same render request across variants. Card measurement replaces Card text; Compound layout replaces Grid placement and Route planning. Render driver and SVG marks retain their identities and change responsibilities. Added actions are green, obsolete fitting/routing calls remain marked as removed, and continuing layout/painting calls retain their identities. Text preparation now precedes geometry.

beats.heading: Pretext supplies line layout; we own card policy
beats.body: prepareWithSegments does reusable measurement. layoutWithLines computes wrapping for a chosen width and lineHeight. Archboard decides readable font styles, width bounds, padding and icon clearance. A changed width reuses preparation; changed text, fonts or configuration needs preparation again.

beats.heading: Prove the server font host
beats.body: Pretext currently hard-codes Canvas2D and has no public measurement injection. Bun here has no OffscreenCanvas or document. Prefer a supported adapter to our existing bundled-font measurer; that needs upstream support or an evaluated adaptation. A native server Canvas is the alternative, subject to browser-metric checks. No fake browser global and no browser-owned canonical layout. Source: https://github.com/chenglou/pretext/blob/5ac3fd17ff8079274f45103bf09e294ac345c187/src/measurement.ts

beats.heading: Placement and routing become one contract
beats.body: The separate grid/corridor handoff disappears. The compound owner can iterate sibling positions, container bounds, ports, paths and label clearances internally, returning one final drawing. Its engine remains to be selected and benchmarked; these steps state required behavior rather than invented library calls.

beats.heading: The painter stops making geometry decisions
beats.body: Paint supplied wrapped lines and final paths. Build atlas boxes from that same drawing. No new wrapping, truncation or label settlement occurs after layout. The server/browser response fields remain unchanged.
